nakshatra.name: Mrigashira
nakshatra.characteristics: These natives are curious, quick-witted, and have a thirst for exploration. They are natural seekers who enjoy learning and adapting to new experiences.

yoga.name: Saubhagya
yoga.characteristics: Good Wealth (enjoys a contented life full of prospects, happy)

karana.name: Gar
karana.characteristics: As per Astrology, people of Gar Karana are punctilious. They trust in their aptitude not fortune. They attain their desired objective by hard work and effort.
